name: Medical Campus
note: Catalog teaching buildings (BUILDING_ALIASES in build_map_data.py). Each footprint is the OSM building whose address or name matches BU's published building directory; lat/lon is that footprint's area centroid. No bbox: these sit inside the campus bbox and must not widen it. Capacity is the catalog's deduplicated classroom-seat sum (unknown rooms 24 seats), not occupancy.
